completedStage.rendering: Original PNG through an img element with object-fit: contain. No image filters, canvas redraw, new generation, crop or re-encoding.

intermediateStages.type: Approved 1536x1024 PNG construction artwork; optional SVG principles view
intermediateStages.purpose: Preview cumulative construction, chapter navigation, close-up lessons and the transition to the fixed completed image.

specialInteractions.4: Fit the illustrated post foot to a foundation stone.
specialInteractions.13: Toggle heat flow in a separate generic ondol section; no claim about this building's actual hidden channels.

sharedStructure.rule: Posts, beams, purlin supports and rafters reuse shared world coordinates across stages. Rafter support nodes are derived from purlin top faces.
sharedStructure.check: HANOK_STRUCTURE.validate() checks declared post, beam, strut and rafter support contacts.
stageArtworkGate: Match approved master column positions, roof junction, bays, end eave supports and both plaques before accepting stage artwork.
Check actual post-to-beam, beam-to-purlin and purlin-to-rafter placement in the stage artwork.
Keep camera and existing components fixed across all intermediate stages.
Stage 16 must use the unchanged approved PNG.
sharedStructure.limits: Contact checks apply only to this explanatory model. They do not certify structural safety, historical accuracy or absence of all collisions at the main-roof and numaru-roof junction.
sharedStructure.appliesTo: The schematic SVG view only; generated artwork is reviewed separately against the approved original.

navigation: Next/previous, chapter jump, 16-step timeline, all-stage gallery, keyboard arrows and timed playback that stops at 16.
dependencies: Static HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript; repository Paperlogy fonts. No external network resources or library packages.
reviewInteractions: Switch between candidate artwork and explanatory sketch.
Overlay the unchanged completed master with adjustable opacity.
Enlarge the candidate artwork; retain separate fitting, roof-layer and ondol detail diagrams.
